data.name: Bloodless
data.description: (Lesser) You automatically stabilize when at negative hit points, and you are killed only if your negative hit point total exceeds double your Constitution score. In addition, you can allow the Terminator to gain 1 point of influence over you to automatically end any bleed or blood drain effect or effect with the pain descriptor. Doing so is not an action, so you can do this even if you are unconscious.
